description.en: Adds Azure OpenAI account types for the built-in openai platform: a resource endpoint with its API key, served through the v1 API or the classic per-deployment API. The upstream model is the deployment name; map client model names to deployments on the account. The plugin builds each request and the core sends it; the plugin itself makes no network connection. Declares no platform, no endpoints and no prices.
description.zh: 为内置 openai 平台新增 Azure OpenAI 账号类型：资源地址加 API Key，走 v1 接口或按部署的经典接口。上游的模型就是部署名，在账号上把客户端的模型名映射到部署名。插件构造每个请求、由核心发送，插件自身不发起任何网络连接。不声明平台、端点和价格。

description.en: An Azure OpenAI resource and its API key. Requests go to <resource endpoint>/openai/v1/chat/completions, /responses and /embeddings with the key in api-key.
description.zh: Azure OpenAI 资源及其 API Key。请求发往 <资源地址>/openai/v1/chat/completions、/responses、/embeddings，Key 放在 api-key 中。

description.en: An Azure OpenAI resource and its API key, served through the classic per-deployment API. Requests go to <resource endpoint>/openai/deployments/<deployment>/chat/completions and /embeddings with an api-version and the key in api-key; /v1/responses requests are converted to chat completions.
description.zh: Azure OpenAI 资源及其 API Key，走按部署的经典接口。请求发往 <资源地址>/openai/deployments/<部署名>/chat/completions、/embeddings，带 api-version，Key 放在 api-key 中；/v1/responses 请求会转成 chat completions 再发。

reason.en: Register the Azure OpenAI account types for the built-in openai platform
reason.zh: 为内置 openai 平台注册 Azure OpenAI 账号类型

reason.en: The account forms of the v1 and deployment APIs (AzureV1Form, AzureDeploymentForm)
reason.zh: v1 接口与按部署两种账号表单（AzureV1Form、AzureDeploymentForm）
